title: Seeders aur Factories: Test Data banana
objectives: Seeder aur factory ka farak samajhna

sections.heading: Seeder aur Factory kya hain?
sections.body:
Development mein khali tables ke saath kaam karna mushkil hai. **Seeder** database mein data bharta hai. **Factory** ek blueprint hai jo fake (lekin asli jaisa) data bana deta hai.

Model ko Eloquent module mein detail se seekhenge. Abhi `php artisan make:model Product` se model bana lo, taaki factory use ho sake.

sections.heading: Real-world example: 20 fake products
sections.body: Factory mein har column ke liye fake value likhte hain. `fake()` helper naam, price, text jaisa data deta hai.

code.code:
php artisan make:model Product
php artisan make:factory ProductFactory --model=Product

<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;

class ProductFactory extends Factory
{
    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => fake()->words(3, true),
            'price' => fake()->randomFloat(2, 99, 9999),
            'stock' => fake()->numberBetween(0, 100),
        ];
    }
}

explain: `definition()` ek row ke liye fake values ka array deta hai.
`fake()->words(3, true)` – 3 shabdon ka text. `randomFloat(2, 99, 9999)` – 2 decimal wala price.
Model mein `use HasFactory;` hona chahiye (`make:model` khud lagata hai).

sections.heading: Seeder se data bharna
sections.body: Seeder factory ko call karke rows banata hai. `DatabaseSeeder` main seeder hai jo baaki seeders ko call karta hai.

code.code:
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;

class ProductSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        Product::factory()->count(20)->create();
    }
}

explain: `Product::factory()->count(20)->create()` – 20 rows database mein bana deta hai.
`DatabaseSeeder::run()` mein `$this->call([...])` – order se seeders chalte hain (parent tables pehle).

sections.heading: Seed chalana
sections.body: Seed ko migrations ke saath ya alag se chala sakte ho:

code.code:
php artisan db:seed
php artisan db:seed --class=ProductSeeder
php artisan migrate:fresh --seed

explain: `migrate:fresh --seed` – database reset karke naya data (sirf development mein).

callout.text: Seeders mein asli users ka password ya production data mat daalo. Fake data hi rakho, aur production par `migrate:fresh --seed` kabhi mat chalao.

versionDiff.heading: Seeders aur factories: Laravel 11, 12, 13
versionDiff.intro: Factories aur seeders ka syntax teeno versions mein same hai.

items.11: Class-based factories, `fake()` helper aur `HasFactory` trait standard hain.

errors.cause: Model banaya nahi ya import galat hai.
errors.fix: `php artisan make:model Product` chalao aur seeder mein `use App\Models\Product;`.
Model mein `use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;` aur class ke andar `use HasFactory;` likho.

errors.error: SQLSTATE[HY000]: no such column / table products has no column
errors.cause: Factory ke columns table se match nahi karte, ya migration chali nahi.
errors.fix: Pehle `migrate` chalao aur factory ke keys ko column naamon se milao.

debug.body: Data bhara ya nahi, Tinker se dekho.

code.code:
php artisan db:seed
php artisan tinker
>>> App\Models\Product::count()

tasks: `DatabaseSeeder` se seeder call karo aur `migrate:fresh --seed` chalao

quiz.why: Factory model ke liye fake data generate karta hai.

quiz.q: Database reset karke seed karne ki command?

interview.a: Seeder database mein data bharta hai. Factory ek model ka fake data blueprint hai jise seeder ya tests use karte hain.
Faker library ka helper jo naam, email, text jaise fake data deta hai.
Main seeder jo `db:seed` chalane par chalta hai aur `call()` se baaki seeders ko order mein chalata hai.
Development aur testing ke liye turant realistic data milta hai, aur team ka data same rehta hai.

interview.q: Production mein seed kab chalate hain?
interview.a: Sirf zaroori reference data (jaise countries, roles) ke liye, fake data ke liye kabhi nahi.

summary: Factory fake data ka blueprint, seeder data bharta hai.
